name: Ghost Light
body:
School evocation [light]; Level bard 3, inquisitor 3, magus 3, psychic 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (phosphorescent mineral or fungus)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target object touched (see text)
Duration 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts like the spell light except the light is only visible to you and a number of specifically designated characters equal to one per three caster levels you possess. These creatures must be within 10 feet of you when you initially cast the spell, but need not stay within that radius to be affected. No other creatures can see the light and you and the other spell targets are affected by other light conditions.
